blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or take guided cruises on Rollins Lake. Boats accommodate from 8 to 14 guests and can be used for relaxing, fishing, swimming, and tube towing (on larger boat). Guided cruises are 90 minutes with a driver provided. Boats stay on Rollins Lake and cannot be taken to other lakes.
extraNote: Boat rental payment required in advance to hold date · Security deposit $800 cash or credit card with $25 non-refundable fee · Fuel paid on return at $8 per gallon (2024 price) · Cancellation 14+ days before trip: refund minus non-refundable booking and credit card fees (~10%) · Cancellation within 14 days: 50% refund or reschedule · Full refund if rental canceled day of due to unsafe weather conditions minus non-refundable credit card fee · No cash refunds; full credit for state of emergency · Rentals canceled if AQI 201+ on day of rental; partial cancellations at 150 AQI · Illegal to operate boat while intoxicated; passengers may drink alcohol · If underage or insufficient experience drive
